title: Store and DC replenishment
acceptance_criteria: Store sales and stock are shown per store or site for any customer whose reports carry a site; a store is shown by its own name and is never aliased to its parent customer
Every site has a level (distributor stock, customer DC, store, other) and an owner (distributor or customer); a distributor-owned site cannot be set to customer DC

A customer DC exists only on evidence: a customer report or an ASUS shipment names the site as a distribution or fulfilment centre, or a steward confirms it once (remembered). Name patterns and stock behaviour only propose a candidate; a candidate is not a DC until confirmed; nothing is auto-created
With no stated DC there is no DC level: stock sits at store or account level supplied through the distributor, and the module does not invent a DC
Customer DC stock, DC to store needs where a DC exists, and distributor to store needs where it does not
Which distributor supplies a site from distributor stock, with lead times learned from history per distributor and site
Slow and unsold stock with a suggested path: promote, move between stores or customers, or return to the distributor
A store map in the On the water style

Everything is driven by data and tenant configuration; no customer, distributor, retailer, store, DC, product or vendor name appears in a rule, default, pattern or test; the module works unchanged for a customer with no DC and for a customer added later
N-0110 and N-0108 fold in as dependencies of this node
